goal: Own100M-300M generative model eventually better than Qwen3.5-0.8B; not a present performance claim
primary_hypothesis: Symmetric counterfactual sequence-ranking loss teaches conditional dependence on queried key/operator and improves free exact-answer generation beyond positive-only NLL on identical pairs.
start: L100M step1024 BF16 upcast FP32; NEW optimizer, not exact ancestor resume
compute_precision: FP32 weights/gradients, BF16 autocast, FP32 delta math
loss: Positive completion token NLL + lambda*mean softplus(margin+meanLogP(wrong)-meanLogP(correct)); control same forward/backward graph with lambda=0
targets: F=<integer> plus EOS; numerical length matched within each pair; full8192vocabulary
source_change: Only expose unreduced cross entropy; no architectural parameter or inference-function change
generation: greedy max64newtokens; EOS required; one terminalF with optional legacytrace; no candidate list, tools, gold or parser in model
evaluation_selection: Fixed final1024 only; no test-based model selection
limitations: Undertrained own100M base; not full general-language pretraining.
One paired seed, synthetic RU/EN tasks; no broad code-writing benchmark.
Conditioning/length exclusions alter sampling distribution and are reported.
Generation has no manual solver; ranking evaluation sees candidates only as separate diagnostic.
